name: tauri
description: Tauri v2 conventions: command responsiveness, async execution, and generated frontend contracts.

interface.longDescription: Use Eric Tauri in Tauri v2 apps. It covers choosing Tauri, assessing a command's duration and blocking work before deciding sync or async, moving blocking I/O or CPU work off the async runtime, and generating frontend command contracts.
defaultPrompt: Use $tauri for this Tauri command's responsiveness and contracts.
